RIS (Austrian legal information system): UStG 1994, Annex 2 - items subject to the 13% rate, in force 1 January 2016
countryeconomy.com: Austria VAT rate history (20% standard and 10% reduced from 1 January 1984; 13% tier from 1 January 2016)

caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

Effective dates: the 13% second reduced and 13% parking rates were introduced on 1 January 2016 by the Steuerreformgesetz 2015/2016, replacing the 12% rate (RIS, UStG 1994 Annex 2); the 20% standard and 10% reduced rates' 1 January 1984 start is secondary (countryeconomy rate history), not from the authority.
